title: REQ · BootScene unsubscribes transitionTo when the scene shuts down
summary: SHUTDOWN handler releases the transitionTo subscription
description: Context: the SHUTDOWN handler already releases the playAnimation subscription. Desired behavior: also release transitionTo so a dead scene does not react. Expected result: after shutdown, transitionTo emits do nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Given the SHUTDOWN callback ran, when transitionTo is emitted, then fadeOut is not called
Given another transitionTo subscriber registered before create, when shutdown ran, then it still receives events
technical_constraints: Call only the unsubscribe function returned by reactToPhaser.on, never clear()
